subject: boundary-mcp-stdio
text:
- **Vector:** local stdio — the driver's MCP server
  - **Entry point:** `escher_driver::serve_mcp`, run by `escher-session mcp` as a stdio child an MCP client spawns under the invoking user, since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface: it reads JSON-RPC 2.0 from stdin and writes its replies to stdout — no listener, port or socket — and holds the session it boots in its own process (packages/escher-driver/src/mcp.rs:44-112)
  - **Trust boundary:** the spawning client process — whatever holds the child's stdin and stdout; no authentication (the Authentication table's stdio row); validation in the Input Validation MCP server row. A result carries ids, accessible names, control values (a password's or a file input's as the mask) and the snapshot text to the client — a boundary widening ratified by the founder (2026-10-10, «Ратифицировать как есть», by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label; the English wording is the overseer's) — and in the one live trial (`claude` 2.1.296 on the dev host, the operator's own login) that screen content reached the model provider through the client: what a client does with a result is the client's — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-mcp-surface/report.md. Since 2026-10-15-cold-agent-test the cold-agent pipe's one live run is a second carriage: through the `claude` client and the operator's own login it carried the stand's screen — element ids, accessible names and control values in snapshot texts and diffs, over 43 tool calls, no `screenshot` called — to the model provider, and the model's reply returns as the agent-written check the pipe parses and replays (the Input Validation cold-agent check row) — a boundary widening on the founder's «Один запуск, до $3 (Рекомендую)» (the founder, 2026-10-15, by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label; the English wording is the overseer's; confirmed at that chunk's wrap card, «Подтвердить (Рекомендую)») and «JSON-проверка с повтором (Рекомендую)» — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-15-cold-agent-test/report.md.
 Since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot a result also carries the screen as an MCP `image` block (a PNG, base64), a password input in it painted masked — the in-band image the founder chose (2026-10-12, «В самом ответе», by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer); what a client does with it, a model provider included, is the client's (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-headless-screenshot/report.md)

subject: input
input
text:
- **Boundary:** Markup attributes
  - **What to validate:** `aria-selected` · `aria-pressed` · `aria-checked` · `aria-invalid` (control states), `role="switch"`
  - **How (stack-specific):** Read from parsed content — the browser app's remote HTML included — into the accessibility tree by the in-process builder `BaseDocument::build_accessibility_node`, on every element — a select's option excepted, whose `selected` is its chosen state with no `aria-selected` read (the `select` row) —, the toggle by role, since 2026-10-10-snapshot-states; the parser already admits the attributes, so no new input class enters: each value is trimmed of ASCII whitespace and compared exactly, in lower case, against a closed set — `aria-selected` `true` / `false` sets AccessKit `selected` true / false and anything else nothing; `aria-pressed` `true` · `false` · `mixed` sets `toggled` `True` · `False` · `Mixed` and anything else nothing, on every role but the five checkable ones; `aria-checked` the same three values setting `toggled` on a role in the closed private `is_checkable` set — `CheckBox` · `Switch` · `RadioButton` · `MenuItemCheckBox` · `MenuItemRadio` — and on no other, `role_from_name` mapping `"switch"` to `Role::Switch`, where it mapped to no role; a native `input` whose `type` is exactly `checkbox` or `radio` (the private `is_native_checkable`) reads neither attribute (HTML-AAM / ARIA in HTML), and its native checked state reaches no tree node either — a measured absence, its fix owned by a `.andromeda/residuals.md` line (target: next) — the toggle read per role ratified by the founder (2026-10-18); `aria-invalid` `true` · `grammar` · `spelling` sets `invalid` `True` · `Grammar` · `Spelling`, an absent, empty (after trimming) or `false` value nothing, and any other value `Invalid::True` (WAI-ARIA 1.2's rule); the lower-case exact match is a choice — the specification as read states no case rule and no browser was measured
 — so `TRUE` reads unrecognized, nothing for `aria-selected`, `aria-pressed` and `aria-checked` and invalid for `aria-invalid`; each attribute is read once and nothing else writes `toggled`; the added lines hold no log site and no panic path — a value of 5,500 characters builds the tree, and neither an unrecognized word nor the long value is written anywhere as typed (the tree's `Debug` holds neither); the readings have two exits, both closed enums or booleans and never the attribute's text: the platform accessibility adapter, whose nodes now carry `selected`, `toggled` and `invalid` — a widening of that crossing by a new author-derived class, states, ratified by the founder (2026-10-10, by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label «Ратифицировать», the English wording is the overseer's: the builder writes the three states on the node), what an assistive technology reads of them unmeasured until a windowed check (no stand binary builds a platform adapter and the dev host's AT-SPI bus reads inactive), the witness owned by a `.andromeda/residuals.md` line (target: next) on the founder's F1 «Пока нет, перенести (Рекомендую)» (2026-10-14), the headless half — the tree the shell hands the adapter — proven since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions (the `id` row) — and the snapshot, which takes the three from the tree node and never parses the element a second time: `NodeState.selected`, `.pressed` (left out for the five checkable roles) and `.checked` (a native checkbox's or radio's own state, else a checkable role's toggle, a mixed one `Some(false)`), each an `Option<bool>` (only `Toggled::True` reads `Some(true)`;
 `False` and `Mixed` read `Some(false)`), and `.invalid`, a `bool` (a grammar or spelling error reads invalid), written by `Snapshot::to_text` as the bare words `selected` / `unselected`, `pressed` / `unpressed` and `invalid` and by `Outcome::to_json` as booleans, crossing the session socket and the client's stdout inside the ratified carriers (the Driver session socket row) and, since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface, MCP tool results on the `mcp` role's stdout — a whole-screen `snapshot` result is `to_text`'s output, a paged one its JSON line `{"text","part","parts"}` holding the same lines, and an acting call's result its JSON line, so the states cross there as the same closed words and booleans, never the attribute's text; the password and file mask is untouched (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:169-213; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:347; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:395-415; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:63-74; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:169-182; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:219-231; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot_text.rs:112-124; packages/escher-driver/src/json.rs:156-162; tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_states.rs:134-316) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-snapshot-states/report.md

subject: secrets
text:
- **Development (operator host, the cold-agent live run and the 2026-10-10-mcp-surface live trial only):** since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface that chunk's one-shot live trial (`evidence/live-trial.py`, stdlib Python, one `claude -p` with the cold-agent pipe's flags and `--allowedTools mcp__escher`, `claude` 2.1.296 on the dev host) reaches the model provider through the same login — no new secret source and no auth library, on the founder's word for the trial (2026-10-10, «Малое живое испытание сейчас»; recorded at that chunk's wrap on his «Записать по форку 3», 2026-10-11, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label; the English wording is the overseer's); the cold-agent pipe's `claude -p` session reaches the model provider through the operator's own Claude Code claude.ai login, held by the `claude` CLI outside the repository — no API key (the session reports `apiKeySource: "none"`), no env read by the pipe (census `os\.environ|getenv|ANTHROPIC_` among its patterns over `scripts/cold-agent.sh`: 0 — the stub is deleted; the pipe sets `RUST_LOG=info` on its server child and reads none), and no CI secret (CI runs only the shim contract tests) (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-06; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-cold-agent-run-pipe/report.md); since 2026-10-15-cold-agent-test the pipe drives the driver's own MCP server (`--allowedTools mcp__escher`, `--model claude-opus-5-5`, `--max-budget-usd 3`, `claude` 2.1.296), its one live run fired exactly once through the same login — no new secret source and no auth library — on the founder's «Один запуск, до $3 (Рекомендую)» (the founder, 2026-10-15, by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label; the English wording is the overseer's; confirmed at that chunk's wrap card, «Подтвердить (Рекомендую)»);
 the committed live evidence of both runs holds no key, auth header, credential-file name, token field or e-mail address — the 2026-10-15 credential scan's one hit is the `"apiKeySource":"none"` field, naming no key (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-15-cold-agent-test/report.md)

subject: errors
text:
- escher-driver's command refusal is a typed value, `Refusal`: a `Cause` and, only beside `malformed`, a `Fault`, in private fields built by `Refusal::new(cause)` or `Refusal::malformed(fault)`; the cause set is closed at eight (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) — `unknown-verb`, `malformed`, `not-found`, `stale`, `disabled`, `covered`, `off-screen` and, since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot, `fonts-unavailable` — each with a fixed non-empty `&'static str` name, meaning and remedy that holds no path; a `Fault` (`Missing`, `Unnamed`, `Repeated`, `WrongKind`, `OutOfBound`) carries at most the schema's own name for an argument; none of `Cause`, `Fault` and `Refusal` has a `String` field, so a refusal cannot hold anything a call supplied; since 2026-10-07-refusal-detection every cause is returned by code — two by `validate` and the rest, seven since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot, by the executor — and at that chunk two texts were reworded, both `off-screen`'s and each on a recorded word, every other text standing as it was: its remedy names the verb that brings an element into view, `scroll` (the founder, 2026-10-07, relayed verbatim by the overseer), and its meaning covers an element outside the visible part of a scrolling box that holds it (the operator, 2026-10-07, at that chunk's plan review); `Display` prints `{name}: {remedy}` or `{name} ({fault}): {remedy}`, and `Refusal` implements `std::error::Error`; at 2026-10-10-driver-cli four more texts were amended and at 2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit three of the four were restated, the cause set staying eight in its order and every text a fixed string holding nothing a call supplies — `covered`'s meaning states the hit's measured limits
 — a box clipped on one axis stops a hit at its whole padding box, so an element lying outside it along the axis it does not clip can read `covered` though it shows (measured by `stand_act_obstructed::a_target_beside_a_box_clipped_on_one_axis_is_refused_covered`, both layout modes, the instance unchanged; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_obstructed.rs:560-605), and a box with no width or no height is hit at its centre on the element that holds it, so it can read `covered` though nothing covers it (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_ids.rs:60) — and `off-screen`'s that a scrolling box under a transform is read where it stands untransformed, so an element inside it can read `off-screen` though it shows (tests/blitz-tests/tests/transformed_client_rect.rs:183-220), its remedy, the cause set (nine) and the cause names unchanged, a fixed `'static` text served by `describe()` and in every `covered` refusal's JSON line — the program's own fixed text inside the ratified carriers, no widening —, the help of `changed` and of `snapshot`'s `text`, restated at 2026-10-10-snapshot-states, name the state words and say the two limits of the boolean model (a mixed toggle reads unpressed, `pressed` false; a grammar or spelling error reads invalid) — each still a fixed literal of the verb table holding nothing a call supplies —, the node keys' help says `checked` reads a native checkbox's or radio's own state, else a checkable role's `aria-checked`, a mixed one false, and that `pressed` is left out for those five roles, and `type`'s help still says that it replaces and that on a select the text chooses the first option whose label starts with it (packages/escher-driver/src/schema.rs:238-239; packages/escher-driver/src/refusal.rs:74-79; packages/escher-driver/src/refusal.rs:81-86; packages/escher-driver/src/schema.rs:77-80; packages/escher-driver/src/schema.rs:96-97;
 packages/escher-driver/src/schema.rs:154-157; packages/escher-driver/src/schema.rs:197-202 — `covered`'s one-axis sentence as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep/report.md, its no-area sentence and `off-screen`'s transformed-box sentence at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-18-engine-debts/report.md, the two help texts at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-snapshot-states/report.md); since that chunk a refusal has one written form, `Refusal::to_json` — `{"refused":{"cause","meaning","remedy"[,"fault"]}}`, built from its cause's fixed strings — sent on the session socket as `ok v3 refused <json>` and written to the `escher-session` client's stdout with status 1, and a `SessionError` is written likewise as `{"error":{"kind","message"}}` — since 2026-10-12-self-description `{"error":{"kind","message","remedy"}}` — `kind` one fixed kebab-case word per variant; since that chunk each error's kind, meaning and remedy are one row of the crate-private table `SESSION_ERRORS: [ErrorSpec; 15]` — `RecordDirNotPrivate` (`record-dir-not-private`) and `RecordingFailed` (`recording-failed`) its rows since 2026-10-19-session-recording, each exit `3`, so `help`'s `session_errors` serves 15 — which `kind()`, the new public `remedy()` and `Display` read (`Display` the row's meaning, the `Io` and `NotSettled` arms adding their detail as before), two rows sharing a remedy, each later row naming the earlier (`dead` · `no-session`, `answer-too-large` · `not-settled`), and `StateDirTooLong`'s message states its bound as a figure, 94 bytes as given on Linux and 90 elsewhere — each measured, the 90 on the macOS CI leg since 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep (CI#38642493451) —, holding no path
 — every text a fixed string of the table, served by `help` and carried on stdout and in MCP results as the program's own fixed text inside the ratified carriers, ratified by the founder (2026-10-12, «Внутри, с правилом», by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer) (packages/escher-driver/src/error.rs:79-177; packages/escher-driver/src/error.rs:61-69 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-self-description/report.md); the node keys' help since that chunk also states the boolean model's two limits; since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface each is also an MCP tool result, `{content:[{type:"text",text}], isError: true}`, the same JSON as its text — a refused `screenshot` included, one text block — (packages/escher-driver/src/mcp/result.rs:29-104), and an MCP protocol error is a fixed code and a fixed message — `parse error` · `invalid request` · `method not found` · `invalid params` · `unknown tool` — with no `data` (packages/escher-driver/src/mcp/framing.rs:100-129), the admitted request `id` the one client-sent value written back — measured: no reply holds the refused id, the tool name or the filler (`mcp_server`); neither holds anything a call supplied (until then a refusal was held in process only); and since 2026-10-07-driver-command-spans exactly one thing of a refusal reaches a log: its cause's fixed name, recorded as the `cause` field of the call's `escher_driver` span at one site for every refusal `Session::run` returns, whichever of `validate` and the executor returned it; no `Fault`, meaning, remedy or `Display` text is fielded — a `malformed` call's line reads `cause="malformed"` and nothing of the rule it broke — and a cause name holds nothing a call supplied (packages/escher-driver/src/refusal.rs:131-142; packages/escher-driver/src/refusal.rs:160-163; packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:302-307)
 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-command-and-refusal-schema/report.md, the two reworded texts at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-refusal-detection/report.md, the logged cause name at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md
